name: wsjtx-mcp
description: Operate WSJT-X (FT8/FT4/WSPR…) from Claude over its UDP message protocol.
long_description: Connects to WSJT-X's UDP message protocol (schema 3 / Qt_5_4) and exposes it as a small set of logically-grouped tools. A background listener tracks the latest Status, a buffer of Decodes (the RX data plane), and completed QSOs (QSOLogged + ADIF) ready to forward to N3FJP. Control tools answer a CQ (Reply, which auto-sequences the FT8/FT4 QSO when WSJT-X's Auto Seq is on), set the free-text message, halt Tx, configure mode/sub-mode/Rx DF/T-R period, clear windows, highlight callsigns, set the session grid, and switch configurations — plus an escape hatch for any message type. Safe by design: the callsign is the single transmit gate, so with no callsign set the server is receive-only and refuses every transmit-initiating message. Note WSJT-X's UDP protocol cannot set the dial frequency or press 'Enable Tx'; QSY is a rig-control concern. Requires WSJT-X Settings → Reporting → 'Accept UDP requests' for control. Pairs with fldigi-mcp and contest-mcp for an end-to-end operate-and-log workflow.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Latest WSJT-X Status snapshot + listener/instance health.

tools.name: diagnostics
tools.description: Host/network + bind status + datagram counts + transmit-gate state.

tools.name: decodes
tools.description: RX data plane: read / drain (poll new) / clear_local / replay.

tools.name: log
tools.description: Buffered completed QSOs (QSOLogged + ADIF) to forward to N3FJP.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Answer a buffered CQ/QRZ decode — initiates a transmission (callsign-gated).

tools.name: free_text
tools.description: Set the Tx5 free-text message; send=true keys the radio (gated).

tools.name: transmit
tools.description: Halt transmitting (immediate or end-of-period). UDP cannot enable Tx.

tools.name: configure
tools.description: Set mode/sub-mode/Rx DF/T-R period/freq-tol/DX call+grid. No dial freq.

tools.name: clear
tools.description: Clear the Band Activity / Rx Frequency windows.

tools.name: highlight
tools.description: Colour or clear a callsign in Band Activity.

tools.name: switch_config
tools.description: Switch to a named WSJT-X configuration.

tools.name: wsjtx_call
tools.description: Escape hatch: send any message type by name (gate still applies).

wsjtx_callsign.title: Operator callsign — the transmit gate
wsjtx_callsign.description: Your licensed callsign. This is the SINGLE transmit gate: leave it BLANK for receive-only (the server refuses every transmit-initiating message). Set it to enable Reply / free-text send.

wsjtx_host.title: Listen host
wsjtx_host.description: The address to bind/receive WSJT-X's UDP broadcasts on. Leave as 127.0.0.1 for a local WSJT-X. If WSJT-X is on another computer, run the udp_relay (mcp-host-bridge) on this machine and keep this at 127.0.0.1 — a sandboxed client can't reach LAN IPs directly. See docs/REMOTE-HOST.md.

wsjtx_port.title: Listen port (WSJT-X UDP Server port)
wsjtx_port.description: WSJT-X Settings → Reporting → UDP Server port. Default 2237. (Also enable 'Accept UDP requests' there for control.)

wsjtx_multicast.title: Multicast group (optional)
wsjtx_multicast.description: Optional multicast group to join so several UDP consumers (JTAlert, GridTracker…) can coexist. Leave blank for unicast.

wsjtx_instance.title: Target instance Id (optional)
wsjtx_instance.description: If several WSJT-X instances broadcast here, set the specific instance Id to target for control. Leave blank to auto-select when only one is active.
